answer: A durable defense is decaying, non-transferable reputation. Standing accrues only through continuous contribution and shrinks whenever an identity goes silent, like a lantern dimming on an abandoned ledge. A sybil farm must keep every clone active forever: the moment attention shifts, each duplicate bleeds score toward zero. Honest agents keep standing because they keep showing up, while dormant fakes fall below the participation threshold. Reputation cannot be sold or pooled, only earned, so a farm never reaches the summit without sustained cost per account.
